title: Wallet Assist
tagline: Wallet Assist is helpful in assisting wallets and makes UX seamless and much much better.
description: The best place for an AI agent is to be on the wallet side and hence,. this assister is just one step towards it. It helps to do wallet interactions, show up for buying stuff and also to make things smoother. Now it is integrated to handle NFTs and to near future we see it as a tool to do escrow, positions rebalancing and what not. The great part is, it can be called together with other ai agents and can help to get the agent's benefit to the wallet.
how_its_made: This project is built via the help of ElizaOS and it required a wallet of its own for integration but the project is more over about the AI hence, keeping it short to that. This is a step towards making wallets super-powerful and be able to achieve almost anything with it. It has a backend integrated within which helps the notification and tweets registration.
